system.boundary: Build a single-ventilator, dual-patient breathing system using Simulink and Simscape physical networks.
engineering_objects: Build a single-ventilator, dual-patient breathing system using Simulink and Simscape physical networks.
A shared periodic pressure source and common inspiratory/expiratory path must split into two physically distinct patient branches.

Each patient branch must include airway resistance, lung compliance, physical pressure and flow measurement, appropriate one-way breathing-flow behavior, and an independently commanded physical branch-flow control element.
physical_paths: Build a single-ventilator, dual-patient breathing system using Simulink and Simscape physical networks.
A shared periodic pressure source and common inspiratory/expiratory path must split into two physically distinct patient branches.

Each patient branch must include airway resistance, lung compliance, physical pressure and flow measurement, appropriate one-way breathing-flow behavior, and an independently commanded physical branch-flow control element.
functional_paths: Each patient branch must include airway resistance, lung compliance, physical pressure and flow measurement, appropriate one-way breathing-flow behavior, and an independently commanded physical branch-flow control element.

Use feedback from the physically measured patient breathing states to regulate each patient's breath-delivered tidal volume to its requested initial value and requested step to the final value, while respecting PEEP and the maximum inspiratory-pressure limit across the declared patient-mechanics range.
